proposed_capability: An explicit Windows entrypoint starts the existing local Codex harness against the already-running preference certification, retaining the evidence checkout and handing off to hunger only after independently reviewed current-offer proof.
player_save_control_impact: Explicit launch requests a scoped Codex task. The launcher itself reads only process names/PIDs and never starts Sims, approves desktop access, grants input, or reads or writes a Sims save. Agent uses existing authority and authentic current-session receipts.
expected_outcome: Start one local agent in an explicitly identified evidence checkout even when continuity metadata is absent, recover the in-flight preference first, sync reviewed sanitized evidence, then route to the oldest attested disposable BI-002 save.
negative_tests: No Sims start or direct game input from launcher
Missing or ambiguous Sims process can still recover evidence without guessing a target
Known evidence is reused without reopening vanilla or modified trials
Failed agent execution does not retry or mark the certification complete
Existing first-run installation and launch entrypoint remains distinct
rollback_path: Revert dedicated launcher, its handoff and tests. Existing game, git worktrees, native observer and saves remain outside the launcher's writes.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact Windows process, EA native recipient/observer availability and any present-game effect require a local P08 run
Stacked PRs 261-263 preserve their own branch ownership and validation history

strategic_handoff.selected_thesis: Reuse existing process, save, memory and decision owners through one supervised local agent entrypoint.
repository_evidence: #270 supplies a process-aware memo route and oldest-lab ranking without dispatch.
#262/#263 own comparator and native receipt source under separately owned refs.
falsification: Extend normal Install and Play bootstrap: rejected because it can launch Sims when no process exists.
Replay preference trials: rejected because both response effects already have historical receipts.
Build a new desktop clicker/native observer: deferred until actual installed observer capability can be inspected on Windows.
Keep only a written handoff: rejected because the user specifically needs a click-to-dispatch path.
strategic_handoff.bounded_investigation: Test whether a current-process dispatch can carry a bounded operator task and worktree identity without a second gameplay controller.
